services.name: Day pass
services.desc: Some drop-in activities require pre-registration, including group fitness spin classes and adult gymnasium programs. Secure your spot online, by phone or in-person at a recreation facility. Online registration opens 48 hours in advance of the activity. Search through the registration system under "Drop In (Pre-registered)" to book your spot in pre-registered drop-in activities. Drop-in schedules are subject to change. Please call the facility to confirm activity availability if you have questions. Most group fitness classes are offered as drop-ins on a first-come, first-served basis. Group ride cycle classes require pre-registration. View class
